title.description: Short name of the concern, e.g. "API rate limiting".

summary.description: One line: what the concern is about.

findings.description: Facts you established that shape the plan; each becomes fN.

approach.description: The plan's steps, in order; each becomes aN.

rejected.description: Alternatives you ruled out; each becomes xN.

technical.description: Technical notes: the files, code and technical detail the other fields leave out (the writing style says when); each becomes tN.

ask.description: The question to the user, one sentence.

context.description: What the user needs to know to answer it (optional).

tradeoff.description: What happens if the user picks this, in one plain line: what they will see, what it costs and what it buys (e.g. "Old rows are deleted for good; the export runs twice as fast").

options.description: The real choices, each with a one-line consequence of picking it (optional).

choice.description: The answer you recommend (one of the options' labels when there are options).

recommendation.description: Your recommended answer. Required: the user can accept it as is.

questions.description: Decisions the user must make; each becomes qN.
